guidebook.role.description.kinswathe:bod:
An interesting role that can create bodies.

Not sure how to implement it without it being completely gamebreaking.
guidebook.role.description.kinswathe:coo:
An expert in foods and cuisine.

 - Spawns with 2 food items at the start of the round.

 - Can buy food from the shop for 75 coins and a Pan for 250 coins.

Pan Item (150 coins):

 - Holding down right-click for 1s and releasing on another player stuns them for 5s.

 - If you hold out the pan and get shot at, it will save you for that bullet.

 - If used for either purpose, then the pan will be broken and removed from your inventory.

 - Has a cooldown of 45s when used to bash someone's head.
guidebook.role.description.kinswathe:dre:
An unnecessary accomplice role.

However, it is very embedded into the code and is annoying to get rid of.
guidebook.role.description.kinswathe:dru:
An expert in poisons and fabrication of poison weaponry.

 - Can see poisoned players even without instinct.

 - Has cheaper access to poison vials and scorpions.

 - Has unique access to the poison injector and blowgun.

 - Cannot spawn in unless there is 1 other killer.

Poison Injector Item (80 coins)

 - Can be used to directly poison a player upon right-clicking them.

 - If the person is already poisoned, then it will kill them instead. 

 - 1 time use, has a cooldown of 60s.

Blowgun (180 coins)

 - A ranged way to poison a player.

 - Makes noise when used and is visible to other players.

 - 1 time use, has a cooldown of 60s.
guidebook.role.description.kinswathe:hac:
A very busted Accomplice that needs to be reworked.

The reason why it's not being removed though is because it has interesting mechanics.

Haven't decided how to though.
guidebook.role.description.kinswathe:hun:
A born chaser, and an athletic runner.

 - Has greater move speed when sprinting with a knife held down.

 - Has access to the Hunting Knife, a better knife with a longer holding time, shorter knife cooldown, but a cooldown when you stop holding down.

Ability (125 coins):

 - Instantly refreshes all knife cooldowns.

 - Has a cooldown of 5s.
guidebook.role.description.kinswathe:kid:
This role isn't going to be used since it's merged with Muzzler.

However, it does contain an important component so I'm not deleting it yet until I figure out how to without breaking everything.
guidebook.role.description.kinswathe:phy:
An expert in poison cleansing.

 - Starts with Pill and can buy Pills in their Shop for 150 coins.

 - Pills can be self-used on the Physician, so make sure to take them out before attempting mass poison!
guidebook.role.description.kinswathe:rob:
A mechanical being with survival measures installed.

 - Has an instance of poison defense at the start of the round.

 - When poisoned, they are notified. This includes both defended and undefended poisons.

 - Poison defense is strictly preventive. If you are already poisoned, then it will do nothing.

Ability (Costs 150 coins):

 - When used, it refreshes your poison defense. (Does not stack)

 - Additionally gives 10s of night vision and x4 stamina regeneration.

 - Has a cooldown of 90s.
guidebook.role.description.kinswathe:tec: A very interesting and OP role. However, it becomes boring if stripped of it's OPness. Needs to be reworked with major considerations.
guidebook.role.description.kinswathe:mag: An unnecessary modifier. However, it does have a use when converted to Innocents only.
